publicly_readable: The editor's letter (ten themes) in full. The full self-review published in The World Ahead 2024, which restates several predictions from articles that are otherwise paywalled.
not_readable: The body text of the other articles (paywalled), the 'Understand This' section and the forecast tables.

entries.quote: Rapid progress by Ukraine could threaten Vladimir Putin, but a grinding stalemate seems the most likely outcome.
entries.subject: War in Ukraine outcome

entries.quote: Major economies will go into recession as central banks raise interest rates to stifle inflation
entries.subject: Recession in major economies

entries.quote: America’s recession should be relatively mild; Europe’s will be more brutal.
entries.subject: US and European recessions

entries.quote: Some time in April China’s population will be overtaken by India’s, at around 1.43bn.
entries.subject: India overtakes China in population

entries.quote: NATO, revitalised by the war in Ukraine, will welcome two new members.
entries.subject: NATO enlargement (Finland, Sweden)

entries.quote: traveller spending will almost regain its 2019 level of $1.4trn, but only because inflation has pushed up prices.
entries.subject: International tourism spending

entries.quote: The actual number of international tourist trips, at 1.6bn, will still be below the pre-pandemic level of 1.8bn in 2019.
entries.subject: International tourist trips

entries.quote: 2023 will provide some answers as Apple launches its first headset
entries.subject: Apple mixed-reality headset launch

entries.quote: predicting a brief recession in America, a deep one in the EU and a long one in Britain during 2023.
entries.subject: Recessions in America, EU and Britain
